context: Sho and Hina explore the new country house.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、新しい家、広い、ね。
lines.en: Sho, the new house is so big!
lines.style: Bright, direct address with wonder. Quick opening on his name, then a soft rush of excitement. Genuine childish delight—not performed. Warm throughout, with the natural rise of a kid discovering something new.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet agreement, the words settling in like he's realizing it as he speaks. Small, genuine warmth. No performance. Soft exhale at the period—relief and contentment in miniature.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I can't wait to see the rooms!
lines.style: Back to bright energy, forward-leaning. Quick and eager. The 'can't wait' lands with real anticipation—not exaggerated, just genuinely impatient in the way six-year-olds are. Childish and sincere.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Soft observation, almost to himself. Noticing something quiet and important. Small voice, no emphasis needed. The warmth is in the steadiness—he's registering that people showed up for this moment.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: It's going to be fun from here on out.
lines.style: Simple closing statement. Warm, sure, without false brightness. A child's quiet conviction—not a question, just knowing. Trails softly, settling like a door closing gently on something good.
